1. Start with the inspection records.

completion:
Search for water-quality test results with a "F" or "Confirmed" flag.
3. If the test date or sample ID is already known and only one positive test result is suspected, instruct the SIP employee to enter the water-quality test date (or sample ID) instead of answering the subsequent questions.
4. If the potential water-quality incident was a boil notice, ask if there was a negative test result that the boil notice was lifted off of.
5. If there was a negative test result, ask the SIP employee to enter that water-quality test date only. If there was no negative test, proceed to question 6.
6. Ask if the SIP employee also reports the facility to WHD to complete their compliance report.
7. If "No," ask if they report to the Federal government via EPA's Safe Drinking Water Information System (SDWIS).
8. If "No" to both WHD and SD
